A '''straggler''' was a [[Silvo's pirates]] member active in the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="SC 108" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> he<ref name="SC 108 AD" /> took part in the [[Invasion of At Attin]], which was aimed at subjugating the [[planet]]'s population and profiting from their [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]] production. Although [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]] had taken control of the isolated world, the [[youngling]]s<ref name="SC 108" /> from the [[Skeleton Crew]]<ref name="T19XifsgFS0">{{SWYouTube|T19XifsgFS0|Skeleton Crew | Blast from the Past | Streaming Dec 2 on Disney+}}</ref> together with their [[parent]]s managed to contact the [[astronomer]] [[Kh'ymm]], who alarmed the [[New Republic]]. With the arrival of a New Republic squadron and the subsequent disablement of their [[Silvo's pirate frigate|frigate]], the pirates made a retreat,<ref name="SC 108" /> hastily<ref name="SC 108 AD" /> boarding their [[pirate dropship]]s to run away. When [[Kona]] and an [[Unidentified Ishi Tib pirate|Ishi Tib]] hopped on one such [[dropship]], the straggler started to chase it, only to be left behind when he failed to catch up.<ref name="SC 108" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[pirate]] straggler made his debut in "[[The Real Good Guys]]," the finale episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which was released on [[January 14]], [[2025]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref>
